# Siyahi — सियाही

> A multilingual poetry archive by Saumitra S. Phatak with 104 original poems in Hindi, Marathi, and English.

**Live site:** https://saumitraphatak.github.io/siyahi-poetry/
**Author:** Saumitra S. Phatak
**Source:** https://github.com/saumitraphatak/siyahi-poetry
**Languages:** Hindi, Marathi, English

Siyahi means “ink.” The collection explores love, longing, friendship, family, life, identity, and society. Poems are written in Devanagari and Roman scripts, and some belong to more than one language.

## Browse

- [Poetry archive](https://saumitraphatak.github.io/siyahi-poetry/) — language tabs, search, theme filters, and individual poem links
- [Original book edition](https://saumitraphatak.github.io/siyahi-poetry/book.html) — the full collection in its original scrolling-book format

## Themes

- Ishq — love and longing
- Dosti — friendship
- Rishtey — family and bonds
- Zindagi — life and philosophy
- Samaj — society
- English Verses — identity and reflection
